# FigureTile

A headline number with its label: the stats row at the top of a page, in Sora with tabular figures, neutral by default.

`SongNodes.FigureTile` · Data

## Use

```jsx
<SongNodes.FigureTile figure="…" label="…" />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SongNodes.FigureTile" figure="…" label="…"></x-import>
```

## Props (FigureTileProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `figure` * | `string` | The headline figure, already formatted ("1,284", "+38", "92 min"). |
| `unit` | `string` | Optional small unit or denominator after the figure ("of 7"). |
| `label` * | `string` | What the figure counts, sentence case ("High rotation"). |
| `delta` | `string` | Optional change or context line ("+38 added last run"). |
| `status` | `{ status; label: string }` | Optional status shown as a StatusPill in the footer. |
| `href` | `string` | Optional link to the filtered view this figure summarises. |
| `linkLabel` | `string` | Link text, verb first ("Show these", "Review"). |
| `tonal` | `boolean` | Render tonal in the nearest module scope (module hub pages only). |
| `loading` | `boolean` | Show a skeleton figure while loading. |
